name: SD Demon Castle — readable two-head RPG field

building.notes: Independent castle object. Footprint determines collision; roofs may overlap the map.

character.notes: 1:2 canvas, two-head SD anatomy, large readable face, common y=92 foot baseline.

boss.notes: Same two-head anatomy and native pixel size as the human characters; horns identify the demon king.

shadow.notes: Shared binary-alpha ground contact shadow, composed as an independent native PNG.

style.genre: RPG Maker-style top-down dark-fantasy field map
style.mood: Readable warm 16-bit SD characters in a violet demon-castle courtyard.
style.notes: Large faces, short limbs, broad deliberate clusters, upper-left light, coherent contact shadows. Static field sprites; arrows translate objects without walking animation.
